id: The ball holds a Torchic. Would you like to take it?
en: The ball holds a Torchic. Would you like to take it?
it: La Poké Ball contiene un Torchic. Vuoi prenderlo?

id: \bBirch: The Pokémon I have for you is called a Torchic. It's just like the one you battled against.
en: \bBirch: The Pokémon I have for you is called a Torchic. It's just like the one you battled against.
it: \bBirch: Il Pokémon che ho per te si chiama Torchic. È proprio come quello contro cui hai lottato.

id: Your Pokémon were fully healed.
en: Your Pokémon were fully healed.
it: I tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati completamente.

id: \bBirch: Here you go May. Your very first Pokémon.
en: \bBirch: Here you go May. Your very first Pokémon.
it: \bBirch: Ecco qua, Vera. Il tuo primo Pokémon.

id: \rMay: Thank you Professor.
en: \rMay: Thank you Professor.
it: \rVera: Grazie, Professore.

id: \rWho are you?\nOh, hello \PN. Nice to meet you.
en: \rWho are you?\nOh, hello \PN. Nice to meet you.
it: \rChi sei?\nOh, ciao \PN. Piacere di conoscerti.

id: \bBirch: So you're \PN. Oak told me you would be coming here. I've prepared a little welcoming gift for you if you want it.
en: \bBirch: So you're \PN. Oak told me you would be coming here. I've prepared a little welcoming gift for you if you want it.
it: \bBirch: Allora tu sei \PN. Oak mi aveva detto che saresti venuto qui. Ti ho preparato un piccolo regalo di benvenuto, se lo vuoi.

id: \rMay: Hold on Professor. I want to battle with \PN first. They looks like a good first test.
en: \rMay: Hold on Professor. I want to battle with \PN first. They looks like a good first test.
it: \rVera: Aspetti, Professore. Prima voglio lottare con \PN. Mi sembra un buon primo banco di prova.

id: \rMay: That was fun. I better get going now. See ya.
en: \rMay: That was fun. I better get going now. See ya.
it: \rVera: È stato divertente. Ora è meglio che vada. Ci vediamo.

id: \bBirch: Well as I was saying, I have a gift for you. A Pokémon. I only have one though.
en: \bBirch: Well as I was saying, I have a gift for you. A Pokémon. I only have one though.
it: \bBirch: Dunque, come stavo dicendo, ho un regalo per te. Un Pokémon. Però ne ho solo uno.
